disclaimer: Educational estimates from published free-tier patterns. Not Microsoft billing. Offers vary by account, region and date.

resources.title: Static Web Apps
resources.blurb: HTML/JS site on the Free plan.
resources.fix: Stay on Free plan. Custom domains and staging slots have limits.

resources.title: Functions · Consumption
resources.blurb: Pay per run. Monthly grant is small.
resources.fix: Watch executions and GB-s. Turn off noisy timers.

resources.title: App Service · F1
resources.fix: Do not scale to B1/S1 unless you want a bill.

resources.title: Blob Storage
resources.blurb: A few GB on Standard LRS is usually fine.
resources.fix: Public containers plus heavy downloads burn egress.

resources.title: Virtual Machine
resources.blurb: Compute looks free-ish. Companions are not.
resources.fix: Deallocate when idle. Delete when the lab is over.

resources.title: Azure SQL
resources.blurb: Free offer is one small DB, time-boxed.
resources.fix: Pause or delete after the lab. Serverless still has a floor.

resources.title: Cosmos DB
resources.blurb: Free tier is one account, tight RU/s cap.
resources.fix: Do not raise RU/s. Delete the account after the demo.

resources.title: Container Apps
resources.blurb: Consumption grant exists. Replicas eat it.
resources.fix: Min replicas = 0. Delete the environment after.

resources.title: Log Analytics
resources.blurb: Verbose logs leave the free ingest cap.
resources.fix: Lower retention. Stop sending debug traces.

resources.title: Internet egress
resources.blurb: Outbound data above the allowance is metered.
resources.fix: Keep test traffic inside the region.

resources.title: Public IP
resources.blurb: Standard IPs bill even when the VM is stopped.
resources.fix: Delete the IP or use Bastion / no public NIC.

resources.title: Managed disk
resources.blurb: Disk keeps billing after the VM stops.
resources.fix: Delete the VM and the disk together.

resources.title: Container Registry
resources.blurb: Storage and pull traffic are metered.
resources.fix: Use a tiny Basic registry. Delete images after.

resources.title: NAT Gateway
resources.blurb: Hourly + data from the minute it exists.
resources.fix: Do not add this to a student lab.

resources.title: VPN Gateway
resources.blurb: Provisioned = billed, even with zero tunnels.
resources.fix: Delete the gateway after the peering demo.

resources.title: Application Gateway
resources.fix: Skip it. Use App Service or Static Web Apps.

resources.title: Azure Firewall
resources.blurb: One of the fastest ways to blow a free account.

resources.title: Marketplace image
resources.blurb: License fee sits on top of compute.

scenarios.hook: Push an image and run it.

scenarios.hook: VPN + firewall because a tutorial said so.
